name: figma-agent-bridge
description: Figma Agent — local, rate-limit-free Figma → agent pipeline with REST API parity (drop-in local replacement for api.figma.com).

scripts.publish: cp plugin/code.ts plugin/ui.html plugin/manifest.json "../Figma Agent/" && cp -R plugin/lib "../Figma Agent/" && cd "../Figma Agent" && npm run build && echo 'synced to the Figma Agent dev plugin — reopen the plugin in Figma to load it'
